# v1.12.1 — FCM registration and reliable push delivery

## Backend fixes

- Added authenticated `POST /api/me/push-token` and `/api/me/push-token/remove`; devices can register/unregister, rotated tokens are returned to the client, and a token re-registered under another account is reassigned.
- Fixed devices never registering with the backend, which had left the FCM token table empty and prevented Google push delivery.
- Changed FCM delivery from data-only messages to notification-block messages with title/body and high Android priority. Android can now display the notification promptly while the app is backgrounded or terminated; data fields retain the board deep-link payload.

## Mobile hardening

- Token registration retries up to three times and rereads the token to handle network-startup races.
- Foreground handling avoids a duplicate local banner for a notification already displayed by Android.

## Verification and deployment

- Backend compilation and route/FCM checks passed; Flutter analysis and all 17 Flutter tests passed with Flutter 3.24.3.
- Mobile package version: **1.12.1+15**. Both the updated backend and APK are needed for FCM; open the updated app once so it can register its device token.
